title: Bagan vs Luang Prabang: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Luang Prabang for most travelers (UNESCO, accessible, safe, stunning). Bagan for those who want archaeological scale that rivals Angkor — and are comfortable with Myanmar's current situation.

categories.name: Temples & Religious Sites
categories.summary: Bagan's 2,000+ pagodas spread across 67 sq km is a scale Luang Prabang's 33 wats can't match. LP wins on living cultural resonance.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: The $1 all-you-can-eat night market buffet is legendary. Bagan's teashop culture is charming but food isn't a draw.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Bagan is marginally cheaper at $20-35/day but Myanmar requires USD cash. LP runs $30-50/day.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Bagan by e-bike ($5/day) is a great experience. LP is fully walkable — different strengths.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: LP accessible direct from Bangkok (1h). Bagan requires Yangon connection, e-visa, and cash planning.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Laos is safe with no issues. Myanmar has a national travel advisory — tourist zones are relatively safe but requires risk acceptance.

categories.name: Natural Beauty
categories.summary: Kuang Si waterfalls, Mekong river, karst jungle. Bagan's dry plains can't compete.

categories.name: Best Time
categories.summary: November to February is ideal for both.

categories.name: Where to Stay
categories.summary: Even budget guesthouses are charming wooden villas. Bagan's Nyaung U is functional but less atmospheric.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Kuang Si Falls and Pak Ou Caves are world-class. Bagan's Mount Popa is good but secondary to the temple zone itself.

faq.question: Is Bagan or Luang Prabang better for first-timers?
faq.answer: Luang Prabang for most first-timers — easier, safer, no political complications. Bagan for travelers who specifically want Myanmar's archaeological scale.

faq.question: Is it safe to visit Bagan in 2025-2026?
faq.answer: Tourist zones including Bagan are generally safe, but Myanmar has a national travel advisory since the 2021 coup. Check your government's current advice before booking.

faq.question: Which is cheaper?
faq.answer: Bagan at $20-35/day budget vs Luang Prabang at $30-50/day. Myanmar requires USD cash due to banking disruptions.
